issues.description: The method signature for updatePerson in PersonResource differs in parameter order between the template and the solution. In the template the method is declared as updatePerson(@RequestBody Person updatedPerson, @PathVariable("personId") Long personId) while in the solution it is updatePerson(@PathVariable("personId") Long personId, @RequestBody Person updatedPerson). Although Spring matches parameters by annotations and the code will still work, the inconsistency can confuse students reading both artifacts and when they compare their implementations to the reference solution or follow examples. The problem statement refers to the REST endpoints generally, so it may not clarify the expected parameter order.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter order consistent between template and solution. Recommended: use the common convention (path variable first, then request body) i.e. updatePerson(@PathVariable("personId") Long personId, @RequestBody Person updatedPerson) in both template and solution so students see the same signature in both artifacts.
